threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused at the bus timetable — it's like a puzzle that never gets solved, right?
Last night on the 36, a guy serenaded the whole bus with his acoustic set. Oddly somber, but the driver gave him a thumbs-up.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I realized I was home? Seeing the old lady at Kottbusser Tor, knitting while dodging the morning rush, utterly unbothered.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a spontaneous street wedding complete with a marching band, right outside a kebab shop. Happens more often than you think!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows the best taco truck is the one with the longest line, not the freshest paint job. The flavors speak for themselves.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 near Market; a guy was explaining his conspiracy theory about Muni's 'ghost buses' to anyone who'd listen. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Barça games are peak excitement, but the real vibe is catching a local jam in a hidden plaza. That's where the heart is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for 'tapas' in a loud voice at every bar—locals know it's just 'pintxos' in the spots serving them.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the fruit and veg from Ridley Road Market is overpriced. Wait until you really get into it!
Caught a glimpse on the 196 last night; a guy in a leopard print onesie arguing with a mannequin. Only in Brixton, I swear.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Standing in the middle of the tempelhof park, I realized I was truly home when I saw two guys arguing about the best Döner on Sonnenallee.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a techno party that starts at noon on a Sunday and ends with a sunrise jam in an abandoned warehouse. It’s wild.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they handle a BART delay; the stressed face means they're not surprised, just rolling their eyes at the same old song.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a guy reciting Shakespeare. Riders were too tired to care. Only in San Francisco do you get a free show on your commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think the plaça is just for photos. It's actually the locals' living room—watching kids play and friends gather is where the real vibe is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewilderment at the number of tapas options on every corner, while locals have already settled on their favorites.
